What punctuation characters should be removed? The reference uses a variable 'punctuation' from string.punctuation, but the prompt doesn't specify.
Should the bar chart have any specific formatting (title, axis labels, bar colors, orientation) or just a plain bar chart?
Should the words in the bar chart be sorted in any particular order (e.g., descending frequency, alphabetical) or as returned by most_common?
If there are fewer than 10 unique words, should the function return all words (less than 10) or pad with empty/zero entries?
Should the function close or show the plot, or just return the Axes object without displaying?
